name: runtime_stake_delegation
description: The complete history of the stake-delegations cache, one row per mutation: the baseline entries loaded at boot (kind = bootup, one row per delegation streamed from the snapshot accounts or loaded from genesis), the entry rewrites applied by epoch-reward payouts (kind = reward), and the transaction-driven mutations emitted as the cache is updated at txn commit (kind = upsert / remove).

bank_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number identifying this block within the current run; the join key to runtime_block. Restarts at 1 each time a snapshot is loaded, so pair it with the stream's boot id. 0 means unavailable.

slot.description: Slot in which the mutating transaction was committed (the snapshot slot for bootup baseline entries; 0 for genesis-boot baselines)

index_in_slot.description: 0-indexed position of the mutating transaction within its block. UInt64 max for the non-transaction rows (bootup or reward kind)

signature.description: First signature of the mutating transaction (64 bytes; zero for the non-transaction rows, bootup or reward kind)

kind.description: Type of the cache entry mutation

upsert.description: Entry fully rewritten from the post-txn account state

bootup.description: Baseline entry loaded into the cache at boot: streamed from the snapshot accounts by snapin, or loaded from genesis

reward.description: Entry fully rewritten by an epoch-reward payout during the partitioned-rewards window

stake.description: Delegated lamports written to the cache

activation_epoch.description: Delegation activation epoch written to the cache

deactivation_epoch.description: Delegation deactivation epoch written to the cache

credits_observed.description: Vote credits_observed written to the cache
